text:
elaine: Quick sync — post-launch micro-iteration plan. We got a bunch of customer flags and a couple small enhancement asks. Need to decide what goes in sprint A (2 weeks) vs sprint B. High-level ask: triage by customer impact + rollback risk + engineering effort. Can we do a short rubric and owners? cc @devin @marco @sophie :hourglass_flowing_sand:

devin: I can take point on triage. Quick thought: split into 3 buckets — P1 (blocks customer workflows), P2 (degrades but has workaround), P3 (nice-to-have). For sprint A, aim to cover all P1 and 1-2 low-effort P2s.

marco: +1. I pulled the error-rate and page-load traces for launch hot paths. Short summary: model response latency spikes seen for ~6% of users on long prompts (95th pctl). Also a memory leak in pooling that surfaces after ~12h steady traffic (repro on staging).

elaine: Good, so latency spikes (long-prompts) and pooling leak are two clear P1 candidates. Sophie, any customer pressure on enhancements? Which customers asked for small UX tweaks vs blocking issues?

sophie: CS update: Two customers (FinOps and DocsFlow) reported degraded throughput impacting batch jobs — they marked as blocking. They also asked for a UI filter tweak (low priority). FinOps is now on a pilot and we need to keep them.

ryan: For QA, we have a slot Wednesday for a focused regression pass. We can validate fixes for pooling leak and a reduced max prompt path to see latency effects. Need reproducible steps from eng.

devin: Repro steps for pooling leak: run continuous load with prefix caching + autoscale toggles; after ~10-12h memory climbs. I'll open a short repro test in ci with a stable seed. Patch plan: limit pool size and add defensive free() call. Estimated 1.5 dev days + 0.5 day qa.

marco: For latency spikes, I can instrument kv-cache eviction path. Quick mitigation: advertise a per-request truncation policy (server-side) for now, plus a rollout of an optimized attention kernel next week. Estimated mitigation work: 2 dev days + 1 day infra testing.

elaine: Proposed sprint A: (1) Pooling leak fix (owner: devin) — must ship with canary and 24h soak. (2) Latency mitigation (owner: marco) — server-side truncation flag and perf tests. (3) One high-impact P2 from FinOps if it's <1 dev day (ask @marco to confirm).

marco: I can take the FinOps quick tweak if it's just a config change in batching. If it's more, I'll scope it out.

elaine: OK. Sprint B: UI filter tweak + remaining P2s + backlog grooming for next wave (model quantization rollout request). Also, add acceptance criteria: no regressions >1% error-rate, 95th latency improvement for affected cohort by at least 20% for the mitigation.

devin: CI plan: add a long-running soak job to infra nightly once leak patch is up. Also add an alert if memory growth > 10% over 6h.

ryan: QA will run the soak in staging and a focused canary validation in dedicated next. I'll need the ticket with exact steps and expected metrics.

elaine: I'll create the sprint A epic and link the tickets. Owner assignments: Devin (pooling leak) / Marco (latency + FinOps fastfix) / Ryan (QA) / Sophie (CS coordination). Who can draft the acceptance tests?

devin: I will draft basic acceptance tests for leak fix and push to the epic by EOD.

marco: I'll draft perf test suite and the truncation rollout doc.

elaine: Timeline check — aim to cut canaries Thursday next week, soak Friday-Monday, full roll Tuesday. Any blockers?

marco: Infra will need a short maintenance window for the kernel swap — requesting 30m window.

elaine: Noted. Sophie, can you prep customer comms for FinOps + DocsFlow once we have canary plan?

sophie: Yup — will send targeted notes and offer to run their jobs through canary if they want early validation.

deploy-bot: Note: scheduled canary window created for 2024-11-14T14:00Z (owner: eng-release).

elaine: Great. Follow-ups: (1) Devin open leak PR + CI soak by EOD tomorrow; (2) Marco perf mitigation RFC + rollout doc by Tuesday; (3) Ryan QA plan in ticket; (4) Sophie customer notes drafted. I'll update the epic and slack with links. If no objections, I'm locking sprint A scope now. :checkered_flag:

devin: No objections from eng.

marco: Good to ship.

sophie: Fine from CS.

ryan: QA aligned.

elaine: Locked. Thanks team — will post epic link here when it's created.
